source_doc: SPP Integrated Marketplace public generation mix (data/raw/spp-genmix/GenMix_2023.csv; delivered wind = 'Wind Market' + 'Wind Self', 5-minute, GMT MKT Interval) — landed by lane SPP-12, measured by lane SPP-32
note: DERIVED, not published: arithmetic mean of the 105,120 five-minute delivered-wind observations in GenMix_2023.csv, i.e. the average hourly delivered wind MW on the SAME average-MW basis as this table's avg_hourly_curtailment_mw rows. Pairing the two needs no hours-per-year assumption at all, which is why the reference curtailment rate is formed from these two average-MW rows rather than from the x8760 curtailed_energy_gwh rows.

source_doc: SPP Integrated Marketplace public generation mix (data/raw/spp-genmix/GenMix_2023.csv; delivered wind = 'Wind Market' + 'Wind Self', 5-minute, GMT MKT Interval) — landed by lane SPP-12, measured by lane SPP-32; curtailed leg = this table's avg_hourly_curtailment_mw (SPP MMU ASOM)
note: DERIVED, not published: curtailed / (delivered + curtailed) = 1097 / (11818.9 + 1097). BOTH LEGS MEASURED — this supersedes the 'implied' basis rows of the same metric for 2024/2025, whose denominator was the ASOM's transcribed wind_generation_gwh sentence with the inconsistent year labels. The metered denominator independently reproduces those rows (2024: 10.56 vs 10.53; 2025: 9.90 vs 9.90). This is the row market_sim.data.renewables reads for SPP's reference curtailment rate (rules 13/14).
